name: CredentialSpec
description: CredentialSpec defines who a credential belongs to, the values it holds, and what it serves.

fields.name: Person
fields.description:
The person the credential belongs to, by identity account id.

 Empty means the person creating it; any other value must be that
 person's own id.

fields.name: Org
fields.description:
The organization the credential belongs to.

 Empty means the credential's own organization (metadata.org); any
 other value must name that organization.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Human-readable description shown beside the credential's name.

fields.name: Fields
fields.description:
The values the credential holds, by name.

 A field named `K` fills the requirement `K` of a declarer the
 credential serves or is assigned to. Values are secret unless marked
 plain.

fields.name: Serves
fields.description:
The agents, MCP servers and git hosts this credential is used for by default.

 A run takes a person's own credential for a target it serves, and an
 organization's credential for it when the person may use it and has
 none of their own. At most one of a person's credentials, and one of
 the organization's, may serve the same target.
